description:
Aggregate the work that makes repository validation one pure function in the validation layer, over records parsed once, with its resolvers, defaults and compiled rules stated once.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure validation-layer function computes the repository report from a captured validation and injected inputs.
- [hard] REQ-02: The validation layer's production code imports nothing from `commands`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Item links resolve against one address index with item kinds resolved once; container pointers resolve through one index per evaluation.
- [hard] REQ-04: Whole-repository validation parses the index and each issue once, and each schema compiles once per report.
- [hard] REQ-05: Plan-document references, the content-format default and the strictness default each come from one function.


## Notes

`crates/jit/src/validation/record_fidelity.rs` (landed under 952ed1e7, 248 lines) adds a record-fidelity pass to whole-repository `jit validate`: stored index, issue, gate-run, gate-registry and event-log records must decode and reproduce what the writer would publish. It reaches the report through a separate `record_fidelity` input to `validate_repository_with_materializations` rather than from the captured image alone, so the one pure report function must absorb or explicitly inject it.
title: One pure validation report over parsed records
